title: Blutac Launcher
note: Workshop feed. A copy ships inside the exe; the app refreshes from this file on GitHub, so mods, scripts and packs can be added here without a release.

mods.name: Quality of Life
mods.author: DavidHiFi
mods.summary: Quality of life changes for Black Ops II Zombies: menus, HUD, weapons and fixes, all toggleable in game.
mods.description: An in-game settings menu, more weapons in the Mystery Box, bonus Survival maps, chat commands and dozens of fixes.

mods.name: Octagonal Ascension BO2 REMAKE
mods.author: HD ERICK GAMES
mods.summary: A Black Ops II remake of Ascension.
mods.description: A Black Ops II remake of Ascension.

mods.name: Zombies Declassified BETA 2
mods.author: Logo2K
mods.summary: A PC port of the cancelled DLC5 expansion.
mods.description: Nine usermaps, the menu mod and BO2 sound and zone files. Requires Black Ops II with all DLC. Installs from its own GitHub release manifest.

scripts.name: Health display
scripts.author: Blutac Launcher
scripts.summary: Shows your current health as a number on the left side of the screen.
scripts.description: Adds a small "Health" readout on the left edge of the screen that updates ten times a second. It works with any map and turns off when you remove the script.

scripts.name: Zombie counter
scripts.author: Blutac Launcher
scripts.summary: Shows how many zombies are left in the round.
scripts.description: Adds a "Zombies left" readout under the left edge of the screen. It counts the zombies that are alive plus the ones still waiting to spawn, so it reaches zero when the round ends.

packs.name: HD textures
packs.author: DavidHiFi
packs.summary: Higher-resolution textures for the Black Ops II Zombies maps.
packs.description: The same higher-resolution textures the Quality of Life mod carries, as a pack of their own. They go into storage\t6\images and work with or without the mod. Anything they replace is backed up first, and removing the pack takes back exactly the files it added.

packs.name: Custom sounds
packs.author: DavidHiFi
packs.summary: Five replacement sound banks for Black Ops II Zombies.
packs.description: Replacement sound banks from the Quality of Life releases. They go into storage\t6\zone and work with or without the mod. Anything they replace is backed up first, and removing the pack takes back exactly the files it added.

packs.name: PlayStation 5 button icons
packs.author: DavidHiFi
packs.summary: PlayStation 5 button prompts in Black Ops II instead of the stock Xbox 360 ones.
packs.description: Swaps the game's Xbox 360 button prompts for PlayStation 5 ones. Only one set of button icons can be installed at a time, so this replaces any other set. Removing it puts the stock icons back.

packs.name: ReShade
packs.author: crosire
packs.summary: Cinematic colour grading for every Plutonium game.
packs.description: ReShade with the Cinematic Colour Grading preset, for World at War, Black Ops, Black Ops II and Modern Warfare 3. Plutonium clears its bin folder every time it starts, so the launcher puts ReShade back as each game opens and keeps the changes you make to the preset in game. Press End in game to open the ReShade menu.

packs.name: DLSS 5
packs.author: DavidHiFi
packs.summary: NVIDIA DLSS 5 neural rendering for Black Ops II LAN games.
packs.description: Runs NVIDIA DLSS 5 in Black Ops II through the DLSS5-Feeder ReShade add-on. It works in LAN games only, because online play keeps the stock ReShade, which limits add-ons. It needs an NVIDIA RTX card, and installs ReShade too if you do not have it yet. The download comes from this launcher's own releases and every file in it is checked before use.
